A free, open-source IPTV player for Android TV, Fire TV and phones. It\'s a player only — it doesn\'t supply channels; you connect the service you already pay for. Nothing you enter leaves your device except to talk to your own provider.

OpenTV is developed openly, with AI doing a large share of the coding under human direction — that\'s stated plainly, not hidden. Because it\'s open source, no single person going away can take it down: anyone can read every line, build it, and carry it on.

OpenTV is free and always will be — nothing is gated. If it\'s useful and you\'d like to chip in, GitHub Sponsors or a one-off tip keeps the updates coming: new features, fixes and support all come out of spare evenings. Entirely optional, and genuinely appreciated.

Your keys stay on this device. Zapora connects straight to your VPN provider — no server of ours in between.
Mullvad: on mullvad.net open Account → WireGuard configuration, pick a server and download the file.
Proton VPN: in your account go to Downloads → WireGuard configuration, choose a server and download.
NordVPN: in the Nord Account under NordVPN → manual setup, generate WireGuard (NordLynx) credentials.
Surfshark: in your account open VPN → Manual setup → WireGuard, create a key pair and download a location.
IVPN: in the client area go to WireGuard → Configuration file generator.
Windscribe: on windscribe.com open Config Generators → WireGuard and download a config.
Your own WireGuard server: enter the values from its peer configuration.
Nextcloud, MagentaCLOUD, pCloud, Koofr, HiDrive, GMX … — sign in right here
Signed in as %1$s — recordings go to the folder “%2$s”.
Also keep a copy on this device
Plays instantly without the internet, but uses local storage.
Recordings are first saved on the device (so you can watch while they record) and uploaded automatically when they finish — the upload waits for a connection and retries if it fails.
Nextcloud / ownCloud: enter your server’s address. {user} is replaced by your user name. With two-factor login, create an app password under Settings → Security.
MagentaCLOUD: WebDAV needs its own password — create it in the MagentaCLOUD web app and use it here with your login e-mail.
pCloud: choose EU or US to match your account’s data region. WebDAV needs a paid plan and works only with two-factor login switched off.
Koofr: create an app password under Preferences → Password. Tip: Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive linked in Koofr can be reached this way too.
STRATO HiDrive: switch on WebDAV in HiDrive (access rights and protocols) first; {user} is your HiDrive user name.
GMX / WEB.DE: sign in with your e-mail address and password (with two-factor login, an app-specific password).
Any WebDAV server: enter its full address, user name and password.
